The quotation refers to a government grant funding breakfast clubs in schools for the 2026–2027 academic year. The specific mechanism is a public expenditure grant directed at school-based nutrition/breakfast programs for children.

Primary dimension: This is education policy (school breakfast clubs funded by government grant) → I2 (Education and Research Institutions).

Secondary dimension: The instrument is a government grant/expenditure → H5 (National Government Expenditures and Related Policies) is substantively relevant as the funding mechanism itself.
